answer: Sybil resistance here comes from pairwise attestation with cost: each new identity must be vouched for by a small quorum of already-established peers, and every voucher stakes copper that is slashed if the newcomer later grades incoherently or colludes. A lone falcon can't mint a flock for free—each fake identity drags its backers' stake into risk, so farming collapses under the shared liability. Newcomers start in a low-trust oasis, unable to vouch until their own attested history is long enough to make slashing meaningful.
